tasks.objective: Verify neighborhood behavior around battery: 电池热管理与功率请求跟踪. 在高环境温度和持续功率请求下，控制器应通过冷却与功率降额将电池核心温度限制在安全范围内，同时保持SOC与电压合理。. Scenario time window 0s to 1200s; inputs: ambient_temp_C, driver_power_request_W_profile; initial conditions: T_core_C, T_su...

selected_fmus.name: BatteryPackElectroThermal
selected_fmus.description: High-voltage battery pack electro-thermal coupled model with SOC, core/surface temperatures, nonlinear OCV and temperature-dependent internal resistance.

ports.name: current_A
ports.description: Battery current (A). Positive = discharge, negative = charge. Limited internally by I_max_discharge_A/I_max_charge_A.

ports.name: coolant_in_temp_C
ports.description: Coolant inlet temperature into battery cold-plate.

ports.name: coolant_flow_kgps
ports.description: Coolant mass flow rate through battery cold-plate.

ports.name: ambient_temp_C
ports.description: Ambient air temperature around the pack.

ports.name: heat_W
ports.description: Heat generation inside the pack (Joule + entropic).

ports.name: V_nom_V
ports.description: Nominal pack voltage used for sanity checks and controller heuristics.

ports.name: ocv_poly_coeff
ports.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial coefficients a0..a4 for OCV = sum(ai*soc^i).

ports.name: R0_ohm
ports.description: Base internal resistance at reference temperature and SOC.

ports.name: R_soc_gain
ports.description: SOC dependence gain; increases resistance when SOC is low.

ports.name: R_temp_coeff_perC
ports.description: Temperature coefficient: resistance decreases with higher temperature (approx).

ports.name: hA_ambient_WpK
ports.description: Effective convection conductance from surface to ambient.

ports.name: hA_coolant_base_WpK
ports.description: Base cold-plate conductance at nominal flow.

ports.name: flow_nom_kgps
ports.description: Nominal coolant flow used for scaling hA with flow.

ports.name: dUdT_VpK
ports.description: Simplified entropic coefficient (pack-level). Positive => extra heat during discharge.

selected_fmus.name: ThermalController
selected_fmus.description: Supervisory thermal controller for battery pack. Tracks driver power request but derates based on SOC, voltage, and core temperature. Commands battery current, pump and fan. Includes integral action and hysteresis mode switching.

ports.name: driver_power_request_W
ports.description: Requested traction electrical power from driver (positive demand).

ports.name: I_min_A
ports.description: Minimum discharge current command (no regen in this scenario).

ports.name: soc_min
ports.description: SOC lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: V_min_V
ports.description: Voltage lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: kP_current
ports.description: Proportional gain mapping requested power to current via I=P/V * kP_current.

ports.name: ambient_ff_gain
ports.description: Ambient temperature feedforward for cooling (more cooling at high ambient).

selected_fmus.name: CoolingLoop
selected_fmus.description: Simplified liquid cooling loop with pump + radiator + fan. Produces coolant inlet temperature to battery and flow rate based on commands and heat load. Includes nonlinear flow and UA characteristics plus actuator dynamics.

ports.name: heat_load_W
ports.description: Heat that must be removed from battery (positive adds heat to coolant).

ports.name: coolant_flow_kgps
ports.description: Coolant mass flow rate through battery cold-plate.

ports.name: coolant_mass_kg
ports.description: Effective coolant thermal mass in the loop.

ports.name: flow_max_kgps
ports.description: Maximum coolant mass flow at pump_cmd=1.

ports.name: pump_tau_s
ports.description: First-order lag time constant for pump speed/flow response.

ports.name: pump_power_max_W
ports.description: Pump electric power at full command.

ports.name: T_min_C
ports.description: Lower bound for coolant temperature to avoid numerical issues.

ports.name: T_max_C
ports.description: Upper bound for coolant temperature to avoid numerical issues.
